protocol.role: development failure diagnosis on consumed data only

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

certificate.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificate.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificate.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

protocol.state_roster: the chronologically first physical gate/v4 action difference on each of all three gated source trajectories; retain a zero-case source if none exists
protocol.physical_action: departures, duration and sorted per-class completion offsets; lane permutations are equal
protocol.intervention: replay the identical gated prefix; force v4 versus gate once; then use memoized frozen v4 K26 in both branches until the identical original population drains
protocol.sign: all effects are gate-first minus v4-first in job-seconds
protocol.decomposition: full gate-v4 = first action under common v4 + remaining full-gate versus gate-once suffix, for total flow and each flow component
protocol.diagnostic_work: native source work, deterministic v4 shadow cache misses, action audits, replay frames and common-v4 cache misses are reported separately; shadow and continuation add no random draws
protocol.stopping_rule: three registered source trajectories once, at most one first divergence and two replay branches per source; no threshold fitting, extra states, extra seeds, repeated planning samples or confirmation data
protocol.interpretation: local first-action direction and later gated-policy feedback only; correlated planning runs on one arrival tape are not independent replicates

limitations: The first-action intervention is local to one policy-induced state and cannot reconstruct later gate decisions by itself.
The post-first suffix combines later gate choices with their state feedback; it is not a pure state-feedback effect.
All planning seeds share one consumed real-arrival tape and are correlated descriptive cases, not independent replicates.
